spans.s: न्य्-उ᳙प्त mfn. thrown down, cast (dice), scattered, sown, offered, RV.; &c.
न्य्-उप्य. See नि-वप्.
= न्यूङ्ख, L.
proper, right
pleasing, agreeable, L.
the insertion of the sound ओ (in different places with difference of quantity and accentuation) in the recitation of hymns, Br.; ŚrS. &c. (cf. Pāṇ. i, 2, 34, Sch.)

न्य्-√ उच् P. -उच्यति (pf. -उवोच), to delight or take pleasure in (acc. or loc.), RV.;
to like to stay in or with (loc.), AV.
न्य्-√ उद् or उन्द् (only p. Ā. -उन्दमान), to dip, sprinkle, ŚāṅkhBr.
न्य्-√ उद् or उन्द् (only p. Ā. -उन्दमान), to dip, sprinkle, ŚāṅkhBr.
न्य्-˚उत्त mfn. dipped in, sprinkled with (loc.), ŚBr.
न्य्-√ उब्ज् P. -उब्जति, to bend or press or throw upside down, upset, overthrow, SV.; AV.; Br.
turned or bent downwards, lying with the face downwards, looking downwards, KātyŚr.; MBh.; Hariv.; Suśr.
hump-backed, crooked-backed (as the result of disease, cf. Pāṇ. vii, 3, 61), L.
convex, W.
N. of the Nyag-rodha tree in Kuru-kṣetra, AitBr.
the fruit of the Averrhoa Carambola, L.
or n. = श्राद्धादि-पात्र-भेद, दर्भमयश्रुच्, or कुश-श्रुच्, L.
न्युब्ज—खड्ग m. a crooked sword, a sabre, L.
न्य्-˚उब्जक mf(इका)n. = next Comm. on TāṇḍBr.
न्य्-˚उब्जि-मत् mfn. bent, crooked, TāṇḍBr.
न्य्-√ उभ् P. -उभ्नाति (impf. -औभ्नात्), to keep down or together, RV. iv, 19, 4.
न्य्-√ उष् P. -ओषति (Impv. -ओषतात्), to burn down, consume or destroy utterly, RV.; AV.
with the Nyūṅkha, ŚāṅkhŚr.
to be inserted, ŚāṅkhŚr.
stumbling, ŚāṅkhBr.

Nom. P. ˚यति, to insert the Nyūṅkha, Br.; ŚrS.;
 Ā. (न्यू॑ङ्खयते) to growl (as a hungry animal), RV. x, 94, 3.
= ˚खनीय, AitBr.
न्य्-ऊ᳙न mf(आ)n. (fr. नि with ऊन) less, diminished, defective, deficient (opp. to अति-रिक्त, अधिक, पूर्ण), destitute or deprived of (instr. or comp.), inferior to (abl.), Br.; GṛŚrS.; MBh.; Suśr. &c.
(with पादैः) having a defect in the feet, BhP.
low, vile, base, mean, MBh.; Var.; Pur.
न्य्-ऊ᳙न n. euphem. = vulva, TS.; ŚBr.
want or omission of one of the 5 members in a Nyāya argument, Nyāyas.
(अम्), ind. less, Hariv.; Var.
न्य्-ऊन—तर mfn. falling below a standard, Divyāv.
न्य्-ऊन—तरम् (अम्), ind. still less, Var.
lower or deeper, MārkP.
न्य्-ऊन—ता f. (MBh. &c.) inferiority to (abl.)
न्य्-ऊन—त्व n. (Madhus.) inferiority to (abl.)
want, deficiency, incompleteness.
न्य्-ऊन—पञ्चाशद्-भाव m. ‘having 49 (not full 50) properties of human nature’, an idiot, L.
न्य्-ऊन—पदता f.
न्य्-ऊन—पद˚त्व n. want of one word in a sentence, Sāh.
न्य्-ऊन—भाव m. inferiority, deficiency, MBh.
mf(आ)n. defective in letters or syllables, ŚBr.
mf(आ)n. defective in a limb or organ, maimed, mutilated, imperfect, W.
less or more, unequal
inequality, difference, ŚāṅkhGṛ.
न्यूनाधिक—विभक्त mfn. one who has received too little or too much at the division of an inheritance, Yājñ.
न्यूनाधिक—विभाग m. unequal partition, W.
having less or more limbs or organs (than necessary), Suśr.
want or surplus (e.g. of an organ), Hcat.
= क्षयाह, Gaṇit.
wanting some organ or sense, deficient, imperfect (as blind, deaf &c.), W.
Nom. P. ˚यति, to lessen, diminish, Bhaṭṭ., Sch.
in comp. for न्यून.
न्यूनी—√ कृ to make less, lessen, diminish, Bhaṭṭ., Sch.
न्यूनी—भाव m. state of deficiency, incompleteness, L.
न्य्-√ ऊह् Ā. -ऊहते, to push in for one's self, drive into one's own stable, TāṇḍBr.
न्य्-√ ऊह् Ā. -ओहते, to heed or to appear, RV. v, 52, 11.
